design: 6 valid_train tasks x 3 genomes x 2 seeds = 36 episodes
assumptions: horizon=30, same execution layer as Pilot 1
Pilot 1 observed: 30 HTTP, 8418 in, 122 out, $0.0026718 for 29 steps
per-request reservation 2000 in + 128 out peak; actual settles to real usage
no automatic retries; BillingBlocked stops the arm
estimated cost is LOCAL estimate, not provider invoice

recommended_cap.note: cap must allow BillingBlocked fail-closed without mid-experiment top-up

scale_risk: If all genomes fail (performance=0), 36 episodes still yield cost-difference signal only — insufficient for Gate 2/3. Budget is acceptable; scientific risk is zero-success degeneracy, not dollars.
